description.en: The configuration ID. You can call the [ListVideoProcessings](~~ListVideoProcessings~~) operation to obtain the configuration ID.

description.zh: 配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者功能配置，只有传了functionName才生效。
description.en: The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global or rule configurations. This parameter takes effect only when functionName is specified.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1。
description.en: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500。
description.en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500.

description.zh: 规则名，可以查出规则名为所传字段的那条规则，只有传了functionName才生效。
description.en: The rule name. You can use this parameter to query the rule that matches the specified name. This parameter takes effect only when functionName is specified.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

description.zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0。
description.en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0.

title.zh: 查询站点视频处理配置列表
title.en: Query video processing configurations for a site
